title: Short Point Lists for CNFs and Stronger Constant-Depth Circuit Hardness
summary: We give a short-description decomposition of bounded-width CNFs. For every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, every width-$b$ CNF on $m$ variables is an exact disjoint union of at most $2^{\varepsilon m}$ width-$b$ CNFs, each determined by $2^{O_\varepsilon(b)}\log(m+1)$ satisfying assignments. For every fixed $d\ge3$, we prove a worst-case size lower bound of $2^{Ω_d((n\log n)^{1/(d-1)})}$ against depth-at-most-$d$ unbounded-fan-in AND/OR circuits with input negations for three polynomial-time Boolean families: inverse trace over binary fields, the Goldreich--Tal trilinear function, and OpenAI's…
